sloka: तत: सुमन्त्रेण गुहेन चैव समीयतू राजसुतावरण्ये।दिवाकरश्चैव निशाकरश्च यथाम्बरे शुक्रबृहस्पतिभ्याम् ॥ २.९९.४१॥
transliteration: tata: sumantreṇa guhena caiva samīyatū rājasutāvaraṇye।divākaraścaiva niśākaraśca yathāmbare śukrabṛhaspatibhyām ॥ 2.99.41॥

translations.english: Thereafter, princes Rama and Lakshmana joined Sumantra and Guha in the forest like the Sun and the Moon meeting the planets Sukra and Brihaspati in the sky.
